blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The Quezon provincial government is using aerial drone technology to gather accurate data for disaster preparedness and manage its natural and agricultural resources. “The drone mapping aims to collect geospatial data and aerial imagery that can serve as a basis for improved planning in agriculture, disaster preparedness, environmental protection, and resource management,” the provincial government’s Public Information Office (PIO) said in a report on Wednesday. From Sept. 22 to 24, the Office of the Provincial Agriculturist (OPA), in coordination with the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) and the Provincial Government Environment and Natural Resources Office […]...
